thread:
Maria Gonzalez: Quick sync on private deploy roadmap decisions: customer-managed networking modes and rollback lanes. Need final call today.
Kevin Huang: I'm in. First: capture real field constraints, don't bake in assumptions.
Liz Patel: Customers want <10m downtime for patches, clear rollback, and a lightweight netowner consent flow.
Tony Ops: Many on-prem netops won't let us change routes. Plan needs manual handshake + automated validations.
Maria Gonzalez: Proposal: two primary lanes — auto-handshake (route updates allowed) and manual-handshake (netowner approves). Publish migration contracts.
Kevin Huang: Auto-handshake needs fallback: if peering not accepted, flip traffic to hosted fallback for 5min, emit alert, then retry.
Sam Iyer: Capture metrics: handshake_success, handshake_failures, fallback_count, rollback_count, post-upgrade-drift.
Liz Patel: GA acceptance: 1) handshake success >=95% in pilots, 2) ops playbook exists, 3) rollback tested E2E.
Tony Ops: Rollback test plan: snapshot config, run preflight that simulates version delta, staged rollback with healthgate checks.
Kevin Huang: Note: KV cache/embeddings schema changes can block rollbacks. Need a migration shim or documented irreversible upgrade path.
Maria Gonzalez: Add to GA: migration shim OR documented guided rollback steps when incompatible.
Liz Patel: Netowner UX: single authorization URL (OAuth-like) with scoped consent + webhook callback to our installer for automation.
Tony Ops: For air-gapped customers, support signed-manifest upload that installer consumes and verifies.
Sam Iyer: So handshake modes = OAuth-auto, portal-manual, offline-signed-manifest. Call out in README and playbook.
Maria Gonzalez: Upgrade SLA targets: minor <10m, major <2h (with rolling option). Document zero-downtime prerequisites for Dedicated (>=3 nodes, consistent KV).
Kevin Huang: Add telemetry tags: handshake_mode, upgrade_type, rollback_initiated_by, fallback_triggered.
Liz Patel: I'll draft GA checklist + customer comms template by Friday EOD.
Tony Ops: Ops playbook snippet to include: preflight checks, snapshot, rolling-upgrade params, health-check timeouts.
sre-bot: Note: staging cluster-3 updated to 0.9.1-rc at 1755554500, run regression suite.
Maria Gonzalez: Owners: Product (Liz) - comms & GA criteria; Infra (Kevin) - handshake impl & rollback plumbing; Ops (Tony) - playbook & tests; Research (Sam) - cache migration validation.
Kevin Huang: I'll post a handshake-state-machine design doc link when ready.
Maria Gonzalez: Schedule: one-hour pilot walkthrough next Tue 10am PT. Invite sent.
Liz Patel: I'll make two docs: Quickstart + Netops deep-dive. Keep public docs concise.
Maria Gonzalez: Great. Reconvene after Liz's checklist and Kevin's design. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
